messages:
Nina P: Heads-up: found two regressions in the v1->v2 migration guide that just landed in PR 1760.
Jon M: which ones?
Nina P: 1) the streaming example still uses `client.stream_response(model_name="redwood-2")` (param rename). 2) the embeddings snippet references `/v1/embeddings` URL.
Ravi K: Yikes. The streaming bit also shows `on_token` callback signature that changed in the SDK (now `on_token(token, meta)`), customers will hit TypeError.
Jon M: Can you paste the snippet?
Nina P: Sure:
```python
# streaming example (old)
for chunk in client.stream_response(model_name="redwood-2", prompt="Hello"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
This will fail in v2.
Ravi K: Suggested fix: show both the v2 code and a tiny migration section.
Jon M: I'll open a hotfix PR to update examples + add a short migration note for callback signature and param rename. PR 1765 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1765
docs-bot: lint: snippets/streaming.py line 12 -> uses deprecated param 'model_name' (rule: examples/params).
Nina P: Can we add a small shim snippet for customers who can't update immediately? Something like:
```python
def stream_compat(client, *args, **kwargs):
    if 'model_name' in kwargs:
        kwargs['model'] = kwargs.pop('model_name')
    if 'on_token' in kwargs and kwargs['on_token'].__code__.co_argcount == 1:
        old_cb = kwargs['on_token']
        def new_cb(token, meta=None):
            return old_cb(token)
        kwargs['on_token'] = new_cb
    return client.stream_response(*args, **kwargs)
```
Jon M: I like it; label it clearly "temporary compatibility shim" and call out security/maintenance caveats.
Ravi K: Runtime note: we'll accept `model_name` for 14 days, then throw a 422 with a deprecation header. Add that timeline to the deprecation notice.
preview-bot: preview available for PR 1765: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/1765 (snippets tested against snippet-runner).
Jon M: Also added an automated smoke test verifying that streaming example runs with mocked stream shape.
Nina P: Great. One more ask: update the tutorial that links to the migration guide (tutorials/getting-started.md) to include the quick migration checklist. People land there first.
Jon M: Done in PR 1765.
Ravi K: Reviewed, leaving one nit about wording: change "legacy" -> "temporary" in the shim blurb.
docs-bot: CI passed: all snippet tests green.
Jon M: Merged PR 1765. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
